steps: Register for 1Q and download the iOS/Android app.
Link your PayPal account and complete your profile.
Enable location services and notifications to receive more questions.
Answer each push question (AskVert) — $0.25 lands in PayPal instantly per answer.
timing: Instant PayPal payment per answered question; no minimum cashout.

repeatable.cadence: questions arrive as push notifications a few times a week — answer each one before it expires to earn

maximize: Answer 1Q push notifications immediately — questions expire quickly and volume is low. Complete your full demographic profile inside the app so you qualify for more questions. Every answered question pays up to $0.25 straight to your PayPal account instantly, with no minimum cashout. Treat it as on-the-go pocket change: phone nearby, notifications on, answer honestly the moment one arrives.
who_pays: 1Q pays you directly — each answered question (called an AskVert) pays up to $0.25 straight to your linked PayPal account.
who_qualifies: You need a smartphone (iOS or Android), a PayPal account, and an email. Available in the US, UK and Canada only.
work_available: Push-based and low-volume — most users get only a few questions a week, and each question expires quickly (first-come-first-served). This is pocket change, not income.
what_gets_accepted: Each question you answer pays instantly per response — there’s no minimum threshold and no waiting. Keep notifications on and answer before questions expire.
costs_and_unpaid_time: The app is free to use with no fees. There’s no per-question unpaid work — but you can wait days between questions, and questions you miss expire unpaid.
when_cash_arrives: Instantly — each answered question pays to your PayPal the moment you answer, with no minimum cashout.
